tei:div.tei:p: 575)chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod kyi sgrub skor rnams kyi phyi nang gsang mchod sogs kyi skabs su/ thog mar tshigs bcad rnams la/ rdor thal dril 'dzin byed cing*/ tshig mjug tu dril bu gsil nas dril sang bya/ sngags rnamasal/ rdor dril med par phyag rgya rnams bca' dgos pas/ thog mar pad skor ni/ lag gnyis sor mo rnams nang bskor gcig gis mthar/ phyi skor byas nas nang du skor tshe bsgyur bkan byas la/ mchod yon ni/ lag gnyis kyi mthe bong srin lag rtsa yi phyogs la bzhag mjub mo gnyis bsgrengs te/ g.yon nang dang*/ g.yas pa phyi la byed cing mdzub rtse gnyis bsnol/ g.yas g.yon gyi gung srin gnyis nang du bkug mthe'u chung gnyis cung zad nang du bskums pa ar+ghaṃ gyi rgya dang*/ zhabs bsil ni/ lag gnyis kyi mthe bong gnyis gong ltar dang*/ g.yas g.yon gyi mdzub gung gnyis brkyangs te/ g.yas nang dang*/ g.yon phyi ma byed cing bsnol/ g.yas g.yon gyi srin lag dang mthe chung gnyis nang du bkug nas/ mthe bong gnyis kyi steng du bzhag pa sad+yaṃ gyi rgya dang*/ me tog ni/ lag gnyis kyi mthe bong gnyis nang dang*/ sor mo rnams gcig rjes gcig gis non par byas nas nang du bskor la/ sor mo rnams 576)bskums nas lhan du mdzub mo'i phyogs gtug pa puṣ+pe'i rgya dang*/ bdug spos ni/ de thog nas lag gnyis phyir gyes pa'i tshul gyis gyen bstan khyed cing*/ g.yas g.yon gyi gung mdzub gnyis brkyangs/ mthe bong gnyis srin lag gi rtsar sbyar/ de steng srin lag mthe'u chung gnyis bskums nas bzhag cing*/ lag gnyis nang du bskor bzhin kha sbub cing gung mdzub gnyis brkyangs bzhin lhan du gshibs pa dhuṣ+pe'-i rgya dang*/ mar me ni/ lag gnyis kyi sor mo rnams nang du bskums pa'i steng du/ mthe bong gnyis bsgrengs pa a lo ke'i rgya dang*/ dri chab ni/ lag gnyis kyi g.yas pa'i mthe bong cung zad ring bar byas la/

g.yon pa'i mthe bong gi rtse sbyar te/ g.yas pa'i mdzub mo nang du cung zad bkug la gzhan rnams brkyangs/ g.yon pa'i sor mo rnams brkyangs shing*/ g.yas sor rnams dang rtse sbyar ba gan+dhe'i rgya dang*/ zhal zas ni/ lag gnyis kha gyen bstan byed cing*/ srin lag gnyis cung zad bsgrengs ba'i rtsa bar mthe bong gnyis bzhag pa nai wi'i rgya dang*/ rol mo ni/ lag gnyis phyir bskor tshul gyis g.yas g.yon gyi mdzub mo dang mthe'u chung gnyis brkyangs/ mthe'u chung gnyis nang du bskums la/ gung srin gnyis de thog tu bzhag nas/ sil snyan bzung pa bzhin g.yas 'og dang*/ g.yon steng ma byed pa ni shab+da'i rgya'o/ 577)༈ gzugs ni/ lag g.yas thal mo gyen du bstan cing*/ lag g.yon rdo rje'i khu tshur bca' zhing mthe bong gi phyogs/ g.yas pa'i chung mthil du bzhag pa rū pa'i rgya dang*/ sgra ni/ lag gnyis sdigs mdzub byed cing g.yon bkan nas/ g.yas nang bskor gyi tshul bzhin sbub phral gyen du bstan zhing*/ nang du sbreng tshul dang*/ phyir sbreng tshul byed pa shab+da'i rgya dang*/ dri ni/ lag gnyis gyi g.yas pa'i mthe bong cung zad ring bar bya zhing*/ g.yon pa'i mthe bong ni rtse dang sbyar te/ g.yas pa'i sor mo rnams brkyangs/ g.yon pa'i mdzub mo nang du cung zad bkug nas lhag ma rnams brkyangs shing*/ g.yas sor rnams dang rtse sbyar ba gan+dhe'i rgya dang*/ ro ni/ lag gnyis kyi sor mo rnams brkyang bzhin kha gyen du bstan zhing*/ mthe bong gnyis srin lag gi rtse so so'i steng du bzhag pa ra sa'i rgya dang*/ reg bya ni/ lag gnyis kyi mthe bong cung zad nang du bkug pa'i rtse dang*/ g.yas g.yon gyi mdzub mo dang gung mo gnyis rtse sbyar/ srin lag gnyis de'i rgyud du bskums*/ mthe'u chung gnyis bsgrengs nas nang bskor gyi phyir bstan pa spar+she'i rgya dang*/ chos ni/ lag gnyis kyi gung mo gnyis rtse sbyar/ de'i rgyab tu mdzub mo dang srin lag gnyis rang rang gi phyogs dang rtse sbyar/

578)mthe'u chung gnyis brkyangs/ mthe bong gnyis chos 'byung gi bar nas bshibs shing brkyangs pa dharma'i rgya'o/ ༈ sman rgya ni/ lag gnyis kyi thal mo snod stong gyen bstan gyi tshul du kha sbyar zhing*/ mthe bong gnyis lhan du bshibs shing thal bkan gyi steng du brkyangs pa a mri ta'i rgya dang*/ rak+ta ni/ lag gnyis kyi mthe bong gnyis dang*/ mdzub mo dang rang rang gnyis rtse gyar nas g.yon pa'i mthe bong gi tshigs mtshams su gsal pa'i mtheb mdzub gnyis kyi rtse gtugs/ g.yas g.yon gyi sor mo gzhan rnams rtse sbyar b.rak+ta'i rgya dang*/ gtor ma ni/ gong gi nai wa'i rgya dang mtshungs/ ༈ sbyor ba ni/ lag g.yon pa'i sor mo rnams brkyangs bkan byed cing g.yas sor rnams bskyangs bzhin sbub nas g.yon pa'i thog tu rgya gram ltar du bsnol/ mthe bong gnyis nang du bskums pa ta na'i rgya dang*/ sgrol ba ni/ lag gnyis kyis sdigs mdzub byed cing*/ g.yon pa'i sdigs mdzub khar/ g.yas pa'i sdigs mdzub kyi mthe'u chung gi phyogs rgya gram ltar bsnol ba ga ṇa'i phyag rgya'o/ phyi nang gsang mchod rnams kyi sngags mgor pad skor sngon du song nas/ mchod sngags rang rang gi rgya bca' zhing sngags mjug tu bsdu rgya se gol byed pa kun la 'gres so/ phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ gsang mchod rnams kyi rang rang gi mjug tu 579)mchod rol ḍā 'ur chem ring thung gnyis can bya dgos so/ phyag rgya'i zin bris 'di nyid 7skyabs rje mkha' 'gro rin po che'i zhal khrid ltar zab chos kyi cha rkyen du shī la badz+ra gyis nag 'gros su bris pa'o// dge'o//
